text_block_list.text:
Then, one day, I was suddenly summoned to 
the chairwoman's office.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
<chrname>'s performance was truly thrilling! 
Splendid! A massive breakthrough!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Splendid! You have achieved a great result 
that will go down in Tracen Academy 
history—no, in Umamusume history!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I received the highest praise directly 
from Chairwoman Akikawa...! It seems we 
achieved the best possible outcome!
